audit.why: Sivir's wave control and Spell Shield own levels 1-6 (packet chart: Sivir x5); the lane flips at first item once on-hit DPS out-scales her waveclear kit, matching win[5]/win[6] = Kog'Maw. The packet's 'contradicts data' flag comparing overall winrate to per-stage side is a false positive — this matchup is designed as a hard-early/big-late spike, same shape the page already states via diffRating and carryRating.
Spikes sequence correctly: her lvl3-5 push/poke edge, level 6 as her mobility ult beating your poke-only ult, Kog's first-item DPS flip, and the late hard-win via sustained DPS.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere, and breakdown.cooldowns names Spell Shield as matchup-defining but gives no actual cooldown number for it or for Kog's own E.
audit.why: Kit gives Spell Shield (E) an 18s cooldown at max rank and Kog's E Void Ooze a 12s cooldown — concrete numbers for the bait-and-punish discipline the field is trying to teach.
audit.corrected: Added the real cooldowns to breakdown.cooldowns.
